text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Mmh... H-Huh???

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Where... am I? It's such a beautiful 
place, but—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan?
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, welcome~♪ This is the 
"Kawaii☆Universe"!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan?
text_block_list.text:
This is an exclusive space for the cute 
Falco-san, who aims to become the cute top 
Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
C-Cute☆Universe...!? I mean... why is 
Curren-chan here?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan?
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~. You're already cute, Falco-san, 
but you're always working hard to become 
even cuter.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan?
text_block_list.text:
To return all those cute feelings, I've 
prepared a cute present for you!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan?
text_block_list.text:
Now then! Bask in the 'Curren☆Shine' and 
pump up that cute power, okay~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*GLEEEAAAM*☆)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah-wah-wah-wah...!! Th-this is 
a-m-a-a-a-zing!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All throughout Falco's body... Cutie power 
is rushing in...!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
With this, I'll def-i-nite-ly☆ become a 
super cute top Umadol—♪

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Falcon-san... Please wake up, 
Falcon-san...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Nnh~... What's wroooong...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Flash-san? Falco was supposed to 
be shining in the universe...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Were you having a dream of some sort? 
First off, I would recommend getting 
changed.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
20 minutes and 5 seconds until the morning 
warning bell... I must hurry, or I will be 
late.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
A dream... I see. Everything that happened 
there was just a dream.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Still, the feeling of cute power is still 
with me! I'm confident I can make it 
before the first bell right now! ☆"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Through this experience, Smart Falcon's 
running grew even sharper...!"
